Item.Name: PB_EDIT_LETTER
Item.Hint: Click to create a new file.
Item.Label: Edit Letters

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 nCount number := 0;
 saLetterId don_common_pack.tblLetterId;
 sErrorNo varchar2(5);
 sErrorMsg varchar2(100);
begin
 if ltrim( :ctrl_block.df_search, 
 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' ) 
 is not null 
 or ltrim( :ctrl_block.df_replace, 
 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' ) 
 is not null then
 show_error( '16055' );
-- message( 'Parameter cannot contain Spaces or Ampersands.' );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.df_search is null then
-- message( 'Enter Parameter to search for.' ); 
 go_item( 'ctrl_block.df_search' );
 show_error( '0080' );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 go_block( 'valid_letters' );
 first_record;
 loop
 if :valid_letters.cb_change = 'Y' then
 nCount := nCount + 1;
 saLetterId( nCount ) := :valid_letters.letter_id;
-- message( saLetterId( nCount ) ); pause;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
-- message( to_char( nCount ) ); pause;
 if nCount > 0 then
 :ctrl_block.df_search := replace( :ctrl_block.df_search, '&' );
 don_common_pack.edit_letter( saLetterId,
 nCount,
 :ctrl_block.df_search,
 :ctrl_block.df_replace,
 sErrorNo,
 sErrorMsg);
 if sErrorNo = '00000' then
-- commit_form;
 execute_trigger( 'key-commit' );
 else
 message( sErrorNo || ':' || sErrorMsg ); pause;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

declare

 ole_id ole2.obj_type;
 ole_args ole2.list_type;
begin
 if get_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_view_file', label ) = 'View Letter' then
 if :global.letters_for = 'NOTIF' then
 if :valid_letters.letter_code is not null then
 szFileName := :valid_letters.datafile_name;
 end if;
 else
 if :valid_letters.letter_code is not null then
 szFileName := :valid_letters.document_name;
 end if;
 end if;

-- if :valid_letters.letter_code is not null then
 if :system.cursor_block = 'VALID_LETTERS' then
 if get_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', visible ) = 'FALSE' then
 set_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', visible, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', enabled, property_true );
 set_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', update_allowed, property_false );
 end if;
 go_item( 'valid_letters.letter_content' );
 else
 if get_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', visible ) = 'TRUE' then
 set_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', visible, property_false );
 end if;
 end if;
 show_view( 'page_text' );
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_view_file', label, 'Hide Letter' );
 else
 hide_view( 'page_text' );
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.pb_view_file', label, 'View Letter' );
-- if :valid_letters.letter_code is not null then
 if :system.cursor_block = 'VALID_LETTERS' then
 go_block( 'valid_letters' );
 end if;
 if get_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', visible ) = 'TRUE' then
 set_item_property( 'valid_letters.letter_content', visible, property_false );
 end if;
 end if;
end;
